notes: LUM-1327 — the *before* half of the A/B: the pre-fix binary over the same gestures as lum1327-composer-click.json.

Every panel here asserts the defect positively (the frame the click produced did NOT change), so this file is evidence of the gap rather than a passing gate. Run it against the binary built from the parent commit:
Panel 6 is byte-identical to panel 5 on purpose: 'a click that changes nothing' is the claim.
caption: LUM-1327 — the same pointer gestures against the pre-fix binary (100x20, real PTY). Panels 1-3: clicking in the middle of the draft, on the label gutter, and on the second row of a two-line draft all leave the caret exactly where it was — the composer consumed none of them, because the transcript viewport stops above the composer and no other layer claimed the cell. Panels 4-6: the wrapped-draft click and the status-bar click are likewise no-ops. This is the state lum1327-composer-click.json fixes.

panels.label: 1. a click in the middle of the draft moves nothing (pre-fix)

expect.why: the caret is still at the end of the draft

reject.why: the post-fix frame — it must not appear on this binary

panels.label: 2. a click on the label gutter moves nothing (pre-fix)
3. a click on the second row of a two-line draft moves nothing (pre-fix)

expect.why: the caret never left the end of the second row

panels.label: 5. a click on the first row of a wrapped draft keeps the caret on the last row (pre-fix)

expect.why: the caret is still at the end of the draft, on the second visual row

reject.why: the post-fix frame — the caret on the clicked row

panels.label: 6. a click on the status bar changes nothing (pre-fix and post-fix alike)

expect.why: one caret, where it has been since the draft was typed
